notes: All twenty-four descriptions and critiques were read directly; the preserved controller-card-review records specific qualifications and confirms that no arbitrary padding or truncated sentences were found.

Both AI Contribution sides were read together. Reasons Beyond Causes distinguishes causal success from normative authority; Convergence of Norms advances a cumulative explanation; Beauty as Address concedes secular awe before considering purposive communication.

The opposing contributions develop collective error correction, reciprocal justification from the victim standpoint, and historical cultivation of aesthetic standards. Their mechanisms and paragraph progressions differ substantively rather than repeating interchangeable frameworks.

The premise lists retain useful logical parallelism without provenance launchers. Six-word comparisons against both the independent twenty-five-debate window and the latest twenty-five publications found no overlaps.
Normal commas, colons, concessions and independent clauses remain intact. The corpus-wide punctuation screen raised no flags; density was used only to detect drift, not as a writing quota.

The exact user-approved source-note sentence now distinguishes condensed cards from source-exact quotations. Its one-leaf correction preserves all earlier drafting evidence, judgments, scores and the limited-scope disclosure.
